name: fx agent
description: Tiny, open, native coding agent (binary fx). Installed with the official fx.sh setup script, which downloads the release binary from releases.fx.sh.
install: t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://fx.sh/setup.sh -o "$t" && FX_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin bash "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://fx.sh/setup.sh -o "$t" && FX_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin bash "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
